def.brief: Fix the defect the lock's verifier (dwitbuk eyes, claude-opus-5-5) found when reading adopt-prior: the adopted README '### `move` (Python CLI)' example `python3 "/path/to/plugin/mangsang.py" move --target "/path/to/project"` fails exactly as written — cmd_move exits 'say who moves them (--by) or why the human delegated it (--delegated), or --dry-run' — and `move --help` / the engine usage line say `move [ID...] --by NAME | --delegated WHY [--dry-run]`. Make the example carry the signer (`--by NAME` or `--delegated WHY`) with `--dry-run` as the preview that needs neither. Only that sentence changes.
